taskTree.name: Contradiction Review
taskTree.author: corporate-brain
taskTree.notes: New knowledge that contradicts existing entries is routed to review as "disputed" so competing claims are examined side by side; neither claim is overwritten.

parameters.parameter: <%= require 'json'; h = (JSON.parse(@values['Review History'].to_s) rescue []); h = [] unless h.is_a?(Array); h << { 'at' => Time.now.utc.iso8601, 'by' => 'kinetic-task', 'actorType' => 'workflow', 'action' => 'contradiction-routing', 'from' => 'proposed', 'to' => 'disputed', 'comment' => 'Contradicts ' + @values['Contradicts'].to_s + ' — routed for side-by-side review.' }; { 'values' => { 'Review Status' => 'disputed', 'Review History' => h.to_json } }.to_json %>

<%= require 'json'; { 'coreState' => 'Submitted', 'values' => { 'Audit ID' => 'AU-WF-' + @run['Id'].to_s, 'Action' => 'workflow:contradiction-routed', 'Entity Type' => 'knowledge', 'Entity ID' => @values['Knowledge ID'].to_s, 'Actor' => 'kinetic-task (Contradiction Review)', 'Actor Type' => 'workflow', 'From Status' => 'proposed', 'To Status' => 'disputed', 'Comment' => 'Contradicts ' + @values['Contradicts'].to_s + '; update result ' + @results['Mark Disputed']['Response Code'].to_s, 'Occurred At' => Time.now.utc.iso8601 } }.to_json %>
